questions.question: Before using a chemical cleaner, what should a technician check first?
questions.explanation: The SDS and label identify hazards, PPE, handling, storage, and first aid. Chemicals may be flammable, toxic, or corrosive. Safe use starts before opening the container.

questions.question: Why should parts be organized during engine disassembly?
options: To avoid mixing parts and losing assembly order
To make the bench look full
questions.explanation: Many parts have specific positions and wear patterns. Mixing washers, shims, gears, or valve train parts can cause failure. Organization reduces rework and mistakes.

questions.category: A3 – Uses tools, equipment and documentation
questions.question: Why should a torque wrench be used on brake caliper bolts?
options: To remove air from the line
questions.explanation: Brake fasteners are safety-critical. Under-tightening may allow loosening, and over-tightening may damage threads. Torque specifications provide correct clamping force.

questions.category: A4 – Uses communication and mentoring techniques
questions.question: A customer says the motorcycle “cuts out sometimes.” What is the best technician response?
options: Ask when, where, and under what conditions it occurs
Tell the customer it is normal
questions.explanation: Intermittent faults need accurate symptom information. Load, temperature, speed, fuel level, and weather can guide diagnosis. Good communication saves diagnostic time.

questions.question: A motorcycle tracks crooked after a crash. What should be diagnosed first?
options: Frame, fork, swingarm, and wheel alignment
questions.explanation: Chassis alignment affects straight-line tracking and safety. Crash damage can bend components without obvious cracks. Measurements must be compared to specifications.
